name: Aurebalo
backstory: A mason in Gorff, from a line of masons who carried stone up the transit route to raise the crossing temple, before the Salthos house held more than the ground it stood on.

experience.text: Had a child with Merluko, named Aureluko.
Heard that Auroboro and Mekestros now have a child, Mekoboro.
Had a child with Khaus, named Khaubalo.
Had a child with Auroboro, named Aureboro.
Heard that Mekestros and Aureluko now have a child, Mekaluko.
Heard that Khaus and Mekoboro now have a child, Khaoboro.
Heard that Khaubalo and Mekestros now have a child, Khaubestro.
Had a child with Merluko, named Aurebako.
Had a child with Mekoboro, named Aurekobo.
Heard that Mekestros and Khaubalo now have a child, Khaumestro.
Heard that Mekestros and Khaubalo now have a child, Mekhaubo.
Had a child with Khaoboro, named Aurekhobo.
Heard that Khaubalo and Merluko now have a child, Merkhaubo.
Heard that Merluko and Khaubalo now have a child, Khaubaluk.

criterion.standard: counts what he can prove with his own hands on the actual stone above any family's claim to it
criterion.wasted_life: letting a good story about the temple's stones stand in for what the stones themselves would actually show
criterion.origin: collision between his backstory (family claims to have raised the temple) and CONFLICT-02 itself

routines.routine_actions: takes stonework commissions at the market each morning, argues prices down to the last coin, keeps his own tools sharper than anyone else selling there

arc.premise: Having proven with his own hands which stones are his family's work, Aurebalo now wants something smaller and finishable: a mason's mark cut into the foundation crediting the masons by name, commissioned through the market the same ordinary way he takes any job - not another round of argument, just the record set right in the stone.
